name: Read Me
rows: Regional Bank Risk Model
VT–NH–ME sample | 2022-03-31 to 2025-06-30 | Internal management use
Purpose

Quarterly, auditable screening model for profitability, capital capacity, credit quality, funding, loan structure, growth, peer comparison, sample coverage, change attribution and management follow-up.
Decision use
Prioritize limited review resources; this is not a supervisory rating, valuation, forecast, causal study or nationwide banking conclusion.
Primary key
FDIC certificate number (CERT) + report date (REPDTE). Financial names are period-end names; the institution snapshot supplies current structural metadata.
Core portfolio weighting
ROA, NIM and reported total risk-based capital are asset-weighted; nonaccrual rate is total nonaccrual assets / total assets; NCO rate is gross-loan-weighted; loans/deposits uses aggregate amounts.
RBC treatment
RBCRWAJ=0 is treated as not reported/not applicable, not as zero capital. The 2025-06-30 portfolio RBC of 14.25% covers 37 of 52 institutions and 79.0% of sample assets.
Priority score
Relative screening indicator: profitability 25%, credit 25%, capital 15%, funding 15%, growth 10%, concentration 10%. Percentile-based; missing RBC does not receive a zero-capital penalty.
Selected scope
Tier 1: Bangor Savings Bank, Union Bank, Walden Mutual Bank, Bar Harbor S&L, First Federal S&L of Bath. Tier 2: Salem Co-operative Bank and Saco & Biddeford Savings Institution.
Change attribution

Beginning-to-end bridge uses institutions present at both dates. Performance holds beginning weights; weight shift holds beginning metrics; interaction captures simultaneous changes; entry/exit bridges reconcile sample composition.
Important limitation

Public aggregate call-report data cannot establish underwriting quality, borrower-level concentration, deposit beta/stability, liquidity capacity, ACL adequacy, unrealized securities losses, duration risk or causality. Institution metadata snapshot extends beyond the analysis date.
